[Task #3] Title: Database Connection Pooling Optimization
Project: Project Alpha (ID: 1)
Status: In Progress | Priority: High | Assignee: dev1 | Due Date: 2026-10-04
Description: The payment gateway queries are causing connection spikes on MySQL. Configure PyMySQL connection pooling and optimize pool recycling.
Comments / Discussions:
  - dev1: We noticed connection saturation at 150 concurrent users. Increasing pool size to 50 and adding pgbouncer/proxy.
  - manager: This is our biggest roadblock right now; let us prioritize fixing this before stress testing.
  - dev1: We noticed connection saturation at 150 concurrent users. Increasing pool size to 50 and adding proxy layer.
